charcoal.handling: keep covered and separate from sparks
charcoal.failure: rain spoils heat; fire consumes the lot
charcoal.quest_use: restores fuel work after a route shortage
charcoal.equipment_use: feeds controlled fires and powder preparation

grain.handling: keep dry and raised above bilge water
grain.failure: water swells sacks; fire destroys food
grain.environment: wet sacks gain condition loss and obstruct cargo space
grain.quest_use: settles food shortages and seed claims

ironwork.handling: lash rigid cases against shifting cargo
ironwork.failure: salt and lime abrade fittings; impact bends them
ironwork.environment: adds structural mass and corrodes in slurry

lime.handling: keep sealed, dry and away from skin
lime.failure: water makes a caustic slurry; spill contaminates cloth
lime.environment: wet lime raises abrasive smoke and coating
lime.quest_use: repairs masonry and disputed field soil
lime.equipment_use: prepares counted lime pots and protective wash

paper.handling: carry flat in a waxed case
paper.failure: water erases accounts; fire removes evidence
paper.quest_use: provides witnessed terms and replacement records
paper.equipment_use: supports negotiation when seals are absent

salt fish.handling: keep sealed and shaded from bilge heat
salt fish.failure: broken seals spoil provisions; water weakens wrapping
salt fish.quest_use: feeds isolated workers during route closure

timber.handling: brace long pieces and keep bindings sound
timber.failure: fire spreads; saturation adds load; impact splits support
timber.environment: floats, burns and serves as load-bearing support
timber.quest_use: repairs crossings, sheds and flood banks
timber.equipment_use: provides braces, hafts and hull repair

wool.handling: bundle dry and ventilate after spray
wool.failure: water adds weight; sparks smoulder in packed cloth
wool.environment: insulates when dry and absorbs floodwater
wool.quest_use: supplies cold shelters and seasonal obligations
wool.equipment_use: lines armour and protects winter rigging

billhook: close strike; hooks machinery or a braced foe
cudgel: quiet impact that quickly breaks morale
staff: modest attack and safer guarded movement
hand axe: heavy close strike; breaks shutters and braces
crossbow: range-five shot followed by a reload
longbow: long sightline aim; movement and wet strings break preparation
sling: quick ranged cast that exploits height and loose stone
heavy crossbow: long severe lane; setup and two committed reload actions
pike: reach-four brace; ineffective when an enemy closes adjacent
paired knives: adjacent double cut followed by a mobile guarded step
javelins: a bundle of throws or a close braced thrust
war hammer: loud armour break and forceful knockback
weighted net: range-four restraint followed by close control
staff sling: arcs beyond low cover but needs room to cast
hooked javelin: pulls position and leaves a recoverable shaft
boar spear: reach brace pins charging animals outside knife range
handgonne: loud prepared shot creates smoke and commits a slow reload

buckler: turns a clearly read close strike while guarding
rope: secures water, winches, and unstable crossings
quiet shoes: reduce travel noise on surveyed routes
repair tools: quietly alter machinery and damaged works
smoke pot: a single cloud that breaks aim and pursuit
cargo harness: more capacity and protects one lost stack
hooded lantern: controls territorial beasts and reveals glass

route survey: reveals exits and makes detours quieter
porter watch: adds bulk capacity and guards cargo loss
carpenter rig: makes controls quiet and stabilises structures

willow dressing: A bitter wrap that treats one expedition injury.
dry smoke charge: Refills a spent smoke pot once.
sealed tally: A recoverable account worth paper or merchant credit.
pine resin dressing: A single treatment that protects a wounded limb.
brine wash: Cleans one salt or cut status but chills exposed skin.
splint roll: Stabilises one arm or leg injury for an expedition.
tide pin: Marks one tide change so a closing route remains readable.
charcoal key: A soot-rubbed key from the forest storehouses.
limestone wedge: Secures or deliberately releases one marked rock face.
dry lamp wick: Restores two measures of sheltered light.
fletched arrows: Counted dry longbow arrows in a waxed wrap; each unit is one shot.
sling shot pouch: Counted selected stones that fit a sling cup; each unit is one shot.
quarrel case: Counted heavy arbalest quarrels in a rigid case; each unit is one shot.
casting net bundle: One repaired weighted net for another cast.
salt-house chit: A witnessed claim on salt fish or merchant credit.
handgonne charges: Three wrapped powder charges and lead balls.

RELICS.river-glass ward: A cold shard that breaks instead of its bearer.
RELICS.tide-knot charm: A specifically knotted river-glass cord that stills one pursuit.
RELICS.ebbglass spindle: A glass spindle that holds one receding waterline, then clouds forever.
RELICS.coalheart seed: A warm mineral seed that consumes smoke once and leaves the bearer painfully chilled.
RELICS.hollow-bell shard: A cracked bronze sliver that moves one sound between levels and may call unintended listeners.
RELICS.stillwater filament: A pale strand that arrests one local current, but calls listeners to its last motion.
RELICS.flood-mark clasp: A repaired river clasp lowers nearby water and steadies soaked timber once; the resisting load leaves its bearer fatigued.
RELICS.ashglass lens: A fire-clouded lens clears local smoke and exposes one hidden store, while the flare gives nearby groups the courier's position.
RELICS.quarry echo pin: A stoneworker's resonant pin seats nearby warned supports once; its report alerts every listener in range.
RELICS.winter sounding bead: A cold sounding bead freezes nearby fresh shallows in winter, then leaves the bearer chilled.
RELICS.red-clay seal: A fired account seal compels one witnessed local compact; the institution records two obligations for the concession.
RELICS.wreck-light prism: A salvaged signal prism spends lamp oil to mark one unopened store and turn animals, but human lookouts see the flash.

reed sole wraps: guarded movement through mud stores a quiet step
counterweight ring: billhook pulls carry the courier with the target
waxed bowstring: crossbows keep committed aim through hard rain
mill-tooth wedge: axes and cudgels break marked floors safely
smoke lens: smoke conceals without blinding adjacent space
river hooks: rope can recover cargo or cross floodwater
rain cape: storm movement avoids its extra time cost
echo bead: loud actions reveal alerts on adjacent levels
high tread: attacks from above push a target one pace
tide ledger: observable tide warnings also improve salt-house terms
cork float: one valuable stack remains buoyant during a current loss
salt veil: head cover also filters grit and light smoke
wreck key: opens named coast lockers without breaking their condition
gull cord: a controlled coastal descent can carry one secured cargo stack
storm vane: a prepared ranged lane shows the next wind change
charcoal mask: smoke conceals while inhalation accumulates more slowly
resin grip: wet hands retain tool and bow preparation
bird whistle: a deliberate sound can pull trackers toward a chosen trail
coppice map: dense-growth shortcuts cost less time after discovery
thorn weave: guarding in thorns protects exposed arms and stores momentum
ember cloth: smoke and heat can be crossed once without losing guard
limestone cleat: light footwear gains scree grip without boot weight
echo slate: loud stone impacts expose alerts on two connected levels
quarry brace: a guarded heavy load stabilises one weak authored floor
sling cup: sling casts from height ignore partial cover and daze
chalk cipher: quarry marks reveal a nearby cache when examined
fall sail: a deliberate fall becomes lateral movement at the landing
sighting knot: a staff sling reads one more pace and names its arcing lane
gullbone reel: a hooked javelin can be recovered directly when rope is readied
sluice token: witnessed control work is quiet even without a carpenter
cache bell: one sounding per region marks an unopened cache but alerts listeners
scar salve recipe: field dressings restore more health after an injury
load ledger: accounted cargo gains modest bulk and weight capacity but remains valuable
roof nail: a ranged line survives one careful move on an upper structure
fen sledge: a broad runner keeps mud from bogging a carried load or broadcasting the first step
ice awl: tests frozen shallows for firm footing and can break thin ice with a contextual material action
fire rake tooth: breaks a burning patch of reed or timber into smoking ash without a heavy tool
limewash seal: keeps wet lime from abrading the courier and their physically carried equipment
smoke braid: a close strike made from smoke gains one harm and one morale pressure
salvage tally: the first difficult cache opened in a region establishes one witnessed trade credit
counterbrace pin: guarding on a damaged support restores one support and cancels its warned collapse
pitch cup: the first ignition each expedition carries measured pitch instead of consuming lamp oil and burns longer
shingle skids: a carried load crosses released water without the extra exposed action
signal mirror: from elevation, a flash interrupts one marked ranged lane but reveals the courier to its group
market weights: a delivered dependency lot adds one verified stock and extra confidence to its named work account
